name: 8 bit art
subtitle: Pixel stickers, big feelings
description:
Give your messages a little 8-bit love.

8 bit art brings 67 pixel-art stickers to Messages, including 10 classics and 57 fresh designs. Meet tiny cute animals, share a side-eye or a shocked reaction, and add some retro personality to everyday conversations.

Forty-five cute characters and meme reactions use a chunky 16×16 pixel grid. A pulsing heart and blinking robot add a little movement. Tap a sticker to send it, or touch and hold to place it on a message or photo.

The sticker pack works offline. There are no accounts, ads, subscriptions, or developer analytics.

Open a conversation in Messages, tap the add/apps button, and open Stickers. Choose 8 bit art from your sticker apps. The exact steps vary by iOS version. This is a Messages sticker pack and does not have a separate home-screen editor.

Version 1.3 requires iOS or iPadOS 15 or later.

Questions or feedback? Contact seltzer.wisdom7h@icloud.com.
promotionalText: Welcome to the 67 club. Cute chaos, snack goblins, big shrimp energy, and five takes on 67. Explore 67 pixel stickers for Messages, including two animations.
whatsNew:
67 stickers. You know the number.

• 21 new chunky 16×16 meme reactions since version 1.2.
• Meet Snack goblin, Unbothered capy, Big shrimp energy, Yap duck, Delulu bunny, I saw nothing, and the 67 unlocked trophy.
• Five original takes on 67, plus Absolute cinema, Let me cook, Popcorn mode, Tiny violin, and more.

All 46 existing stickers are included. Requires iOS or iPadOS 15 or later.
reviewNotes:
Update to the existing standalone iMessage sticker pack, Apple ID 1366485724. The app and extension identifiers are preserved. The collection contains 67 stickers: 10 existing classics, 12 revival designs (including a pulsing heart and blinking robot), and 45 static cute/meme reactions drawn on a 16×16 source grid.

No login, purchase, account, server, or permissions are required. Open a conversation in Messages, open the apps/sticker picker, and select 8 bit art. Tap to send or touch and hold to place stickers. Exact picker labels vary with the OS version.

This is an iMessage-only app and has no home-screen editor. The web Sticker Studio in the GitHub source is a local prototype and is not included in this build. The public website contains app support and privacy pages only.

The sticker pack contains no tracking, advertising, analytics SDKs, or developer data collection. Version 1.3 requires iOS/iPadOS 15+.

The legacy wine-glass sticker is omitted from this release. Its source is archived in GitHub and is not included in the app asset catalog.
